display_name: Phase1 direct supervised physical mixture pilot
description: Train direct classifier-weighted continuous mixture of six fixed posterior IQ hypotheses, without adding concentrated posterior logits to network weights.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six blind physical posterior waveforms and F candidate features; directly learned six-class mixture
data.tx_sets_ref: Only L_s fit labels enter training; U_s uses high-confidence frozen clean F pseudo labels, no U_s truth, V or test

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Random MLP with zero final layer yields uniform weights, frozen blind posterior and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; DURA only compared after training.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source blind epoch10 and 8192-ID six-class source prior; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; controller new from scratch.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 4096 fixed source fit IDs disjoint from 8192 prior IDs, source views21/22/23, eight epochs final weight; RX8 source diagnostic blend .25/.5/1; no target selection or automatic test.

metric_names: eligible source train exposures and L_s labels
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Train fixed F waveform CE + 0.5 direct six-class CE + 0.2 paired IQ MSE using legal L_s fit truth and high-confidence U_s clean F pseudo target; no U_s truth, V or test.

rows.method: direct supervised six-component mixture with optional convex blend to blind posterior
rows.purpose: learn hypothesis weights directly rather than perturb concentrated posterior
rows.seed_notes: Same 4096 fit IDs as prior joint pilot, fit seed 2026121855, network seed 2026121954, order seed 2026121856; no target data.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Designed after observing posterior saturation and fixed-temperature failure on same source sample; source IDs previously explored. Uses L_s fit truth and U_s pseudo targets only; DURA comparator after fit, no V/test/U_s truth; no automatic target test.
